caption_L1: This area graph is labeled Total number of new passenger cars registered in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2003 to 2019. The y-axis shows Newly registered cars with linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 2,500,000 while the x-axis shows Year with linear scale with a minimum of 2005 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: The peak of newly registered cars occurs in 2015. The data shows a trend of decreasing, beginning in 2003, where after 2010 new registrations increase before reaching their peak and decreasing once more. The difference between the maximum and minimum new car registrations is over 500,000.
